name: CE1
commands:
no flow record PART8-IPV4
flow record PART8-IPV4
 match ipv4 source address
 match ipv4 destination address
 match ipv4 protocol
 match transport source-port
 match transport destination-port
 match interface input
 collect counter bytes long
 collect counter packets long
 collect timestamp sys-uptime first
 collect timestamp sys-uptime last
exit
flow exporter PART8-EXPORT
 destination 192.168.3.241 vrf MGMT-VRF
 source GigabitEthernet1
 transport udp 2055
 export-protocol netflow-v9
 template data timeout 60
exit
flow monitor PART8-MONITOR
 exporter PART8-EXPORT
 cache timeout active 60
 cache timeout inactive 15
 record PART8-IPV4
exit
logging source-interface GigabitEthernet1 vrf MGMT-VRF
logging host 192.168.3.241 vrf MGMT-VRF
logging trap informational
interface GigabitEthernet2
 ip flow monitor PART8-MONITOR input
exit
interface GigabitEthernet3
 ip flow monitor PART8-MONITOR input
exit
interface GigabitEthernet4
 ip flow monitor PART8-MONITOR input
exit
interface GigabitEthernet5
 ip flow monitor PART8-MONITOR input
exit

name: DCA-Leaf01
commands:
sflow vrf MGMT-VRF destination 192.168.3.241 6343
sflow vrf MGMT-VRF source-interface Management1
sflow sample 16384
sflow polling-interval 20
sflow run
logging vrf MGMT-VRF host 192.168.3.241
logging vrf MGMT-VRF source-interface Management1
logging trap informational
